subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and transfer instructions
messages:
From: Security Team <security@acme-payments.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, audit period, and transfer method

Hi Rachel,

We're completing our vendor assessment for payments infrastructure and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II artifacts to close our security review for Q2 procurement. Could you provide the following?

- The latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine)
- A bridge letter if the report's audit period does not cover our effective date (we anticipate go-live in May 2026)
- Confirmation of the audit period covered by the report and whether any controls changed materially since the period
- Preferred secure upload method (we support secure Drive links or a DocuSign transfer)

If possible please include a short cover note with the report that lists which systems were in-scope (hosting, telemetry, API gateway) and whether customer data residency was in-scope.

We'd like to close this by next Friday (2026-04-09). Let me know if that timeline is feasible and if you need a signed NDA.

Thanks,
Alice Bennett
Vendor Security, Acme Payments
security@acme-payments.com

From: rachel.kim@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks,
Rachel

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, audit period, and transfer method

Rachel — suggested quick plan below. Keeping it short so we hit Acme's deadline.

1) Confirm audit period: our most recent SOC 2 Type II covers 2025-04-01 through 2025-09-30 (testing period). We can provide a bridge letter that states there have been no material control changes since the end of that period up to the date of issuance (we should date the bridge letter the same day we send the package).

2) Package contents to share (redacted where required):
   - Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (redacted for internal-only system/process detail) — filename: redwood_soc2_typeii_2025_redacted.pdf
   - Bridge letter (template attached) — redwood_bridge_letter_template_2026.docx
   - Short cover note describing in-scope systems: API gateway, hosted inference runtime, telemetry pipeline, and Dedicated offering (note: Private deployments are customer-managed and out of scope)
   - Evidence inventory (list of artifacts available on request)

3) Transfer method: we prefer a secure, access-controlled Drive folder (link below) and DocuSign for any transfer agreements. If they require an executed NDA, use the DocuSign route.

I've attached the bridge-letter template and a brief cover note draft. Jordan — can you review for anything material and confirm the in-scope wording?

Neha
Senior Manager, Trust & Compliance

From: jordan.blake@redwood.com
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, audit period, and transfer method

All — quick notes from security:

- Audit period confirmed: 2025-04-01 through 2025-09-30 (Type II)
- Controls: no material control changes since period end. We should include the sentence: "Based on our evaluation, there were no material changes to controls affecting the scope of the 2025 SOC 2 Type II report through the date of this bridge letter."
- Residency: confirm that hosted (Redwood API and Hosted inference) are in-scope; Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) are explicitly out-of-scope.
- Redaction guidance: remove customer-identifying data and internal IP diagrams; keep scope description and attestations intact.

I reviewed the cover note draft and the bridge letter template — both fine. I recommend including a short checklist in the Drive folder that lists what evidence we can share on request (system configs, policy docs, change logs).

I'll approve the final package for external release once the files are staged in the secure Drive.

Jordan Blake
Director, Security

Transfer / Access:
- Secure Drive folder (preferred): https://drive.redwood.com/secure/Acme_Audit/ — access granted to alice.bennett@acme-payments.com
- DocuSign transfer link (if they require execution): https://www.docusign.com/requests/ABC-REDWOOD-4521
